# appgatesdp_service_user (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the object.
- `name` (String) Name of the object.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Create date.
- `disabled` (Boolean) If true, the user will not be able to login.
- `failed_login_attempts` (Number) Number of wrong password login attempts since last successiful login.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels of the service. Will be used as claim.
- `lock_start` (String) The date time when the user got locked out. A service user is locked out of the system after X amount of consecutive failed login attempts, where X is configurable in the service Identity Provider. The lock is in effect for Y minute(s), where Y is configurable in the service Identity Provider. When the user logs in successfully, this field becomes null.
- `notes` (String) Notes for the object. Used for documentation purposes.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether the entity is protected from manual updates and deletes. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `tags` (List of String) Array of tags.
- `updated` (String) Last update date.
